**Sixth beta of HMG-API**, the mod manager for Hyundai, Kia and Genesis Gen5W navigation head units. It's for owners who are happy to test and report back.

## What's new

- **Hook maps for four more cars.** With a map, mods can use the car's own apps (the parts that need hooks turn on):

  | Car | Region | Head unit software | Made from |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | Hyundai Ioniq 5 (all trims, incl. SE) | USA | 260507 | the official update's files; the same files as three owners' Car Reports |
  | Hyundai Ioniq 5 (2023 on) | USA | 260903 | four owners' Car Reports |
  | Kia EV6 | Canada | 260206 | the official update's files |
  | Hyundai Ioniq 5 | Canada | 260206 | the official update's files |

  These maps haven't been checked on a car yet. On one of these cars, open the HMG-API app → Settings → **Check the map on this car**, then restart the head unit. A [Car Report](https://github.com/VysseCodes/HMG-API/wiki/Car-Report) afterwards helps everyone with the same car.
- **Install anyway.** A mod whose author didn't list your car or software can now be installed at your own risk: **Install anyway…** under it in Check USB updates (over adb: `engine install <zip> --any-car`). HMG-API warns first, still backs up every file it changes, and removing the mod puts them back.
- **Six new hook points for mods**, on the iAP2 (CarPlay) service: when it starts and stops, and the vehicle information and vehicle status switches. They're for mods such as EV routing. Thanks to Isaac Wisdom. Not yet confirmed on the Ioniq 5's 260903 software, so mods that need them stay off there.

## What's fixed

- **"No Wi-Fi chip found" when installing Wireless CarPlay + Android Auto** ([#10](https://github.com/VysseCodes/HMG-API/issues/10)). The head unit only powers its Wi-Fi chip once Wi-Fi or the hotspot has been turned on, so on a car that never had a wireless package (or after Leafia was removed) HMG-API didn't see the chip and refused the mod. HMG-API now also recognises the chip from its driver.
- **Two mods with code could stop the head unit from starting.** Mods that both shipped their code as `hooks.jar` shared one cached file, and loading the second broke the first; after three failed starts HMG-API's boot guard turned its hooks off. Each mod now has its own cache. Thanks to Isaac Wisdom.
- **A mod whose code file has another name** (not `hooks.jar`) couldn't load into the car's apps. Fixed.

## Downloads

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `hmgapi-1.0.0-beta.6-usb.zip` | Install from a USB stick, no computer needed (Engineering Mode → USB Copy → DSP → Update OTA, or NEMESIS's USB install). Carries the mods below, to install from the app. |
| `hmgapi-1.0.0-beta.6-nemesis.zip` | Install with NEMESIS: unzip onto the top level of a USB stick (one NEMESIS package on the stick at a time) and plug it in once Android is up. |
| `hmgapi-1.0.0-beta.6-nemesis-package.zip` | The NEMESIS package on its own, for NEMESIS's Package Store and `nemesis install`. |
| `hmgapi-1.0.0-beta.6-adb.zip` | Install from a computer over adb. |
| `hmgapi-1.0.0-beta.6-update.zip` | Update an installed HMG-API beta (put it in `HMGAPI/updates/` on a stick, then Check USB updates in the app). |
| `wireless-carplay-aa-2.1.0.zip`, `adb-1.0.0.zip`, `nemesis-shortcut-1.1.0.zip` | The mods, on their own (unchanged). Over adb: [Installing and removing mods](https://github.com/VysseCodes/HMG-API/wiki/Installing-and-removing-mods). |
| `SHA256SUMS` | Checksums. |

No download installs a mod by itself: you pick them in the app (or over adb). Step-by-step instructions: [Installing HMG-API](https://github.com/VysseCodes/HMG-API/wiki/Installing-HMG-API). Uninstalling puts every file back exactly as it was.

## Tested

- **On a car** (2023 Kia EV6, US, 260507), with a test build of this beta's changes: all 331 hook points found, the new per-mod cache, a normal start every time, and wireless CarPlay and Android Auto.
- **Off the car:** every test. The Wi-Fi chip check and Install anyway are tested off the car only so far, and the new maps haven't been checked on their cars.

## Known issues

- **Ioniq 5 on 260903:** Wireless CarPlay + Android Auto doesn't list this software yet, so it shows "isn't for this head unit". Install anyway works at your own risk; a Car Report afterwards helps.
- **Ioniq 5:** the wireless mod's Phone Projection settings shortcut can open a page that doesn't exist ([#36](https://github.com/VysseCodes/HMG-API/issues/36)). Use the stock Phone Projection page for now.
- When one mod's change can't be made, nothing changes for any mod until it's sorted (the plan says which mod and why; turning that mod off lets the others apply).
- The head unit has to restart after installing, and after turning a mod with code on or off. The app says when.
- A USB stick left in the port can start wired Android Auto and stop wireless from connecting. Take the stick out after installing.

## Reporting

[Open an issue](https://github.com/VysseCodes/HMG-API/issues/new/choose) and attach a Car Report. Please don't post your VIN, serial numbers or phone numbers; nothing needs them.
